instruction: Create a new folder called 'Work' on the bookmarks bar in Chrome.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a 'Favorites' folder on the bookmarks bar. Showed bookmarks bar with Ctrl+Shift+B, right-clicked to open context menu, selected 'Add folder', typed folder name, and saved.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can show/hide bookmarks bar, right-click context menus, create bookmark folders via dialog, type text in input fields
metadata.task_rationale: Same bookmark folder creation pattern with a different folder name to verify the capability generalizes
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a folder named 'Work' on the bookmarks bar. Evaluator restarts Chrome and checks bookmark data for the folder name using is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names rule.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_bookmarks) correctly reads Chrome's Bookmarks JSON file and returns the roots object containing bookmark_bar with children
Metric (is_expected_bookmarks) correctly filters bookmark_bar children for type='folder' and extracts folder names
Expected value 'Work' matches the instruction requirement to create a folder named 'Work'
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome (pkill + relaunch + sleep) to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk before reading

Minor: Uses strict set equality (==) instead of subset/superset check - if any pre-existing folders exist in the 'chrome' snapshot, the evaluator would incorrectly fail even if 'Work' was created. Assuming a clean snapshot this is fine.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using issubset check instead of strict set equality for folder names, to be robust against pre-existing bookmark folders in the snapshot (e.g., check that 'Work' is IN the folder names rather than requiring it to be the ONLY folder)
